resources.name: Open-source plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW)

access.notes: Any GGA-PBE capable code with PAW pseudopotentials is acceptable. The agent must install and use it.

resources.notes: The solving agent must perform all DFT calculations with this code.

resources.name: SSSP efficiency PAW pseudopotentials for Pt and Sn

access.notes: Standard PBE PAW pseudopotentials (e.g., Pt.pbe-spn-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF, Sn.pbe-dn-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF) must be downloaded and used.

resources.notes: The agent obtains appropriate pseudopotentials from this library.
